discovery.summary: AI-generated slide decks (mofa slides). Full-bleed Gemini images, editable Mode 2 with manual text overlays, 17+ built-in styles, custom inline + full-TOML styles, PDF-to-PPTX. SKILL.md is intentionally short — read the matching docs/*.md before authoring a deck.

hints.when: Before picking a style — never recite a memorized catalog; the binary errors out (no silent fallback) on an unknown name
Choosing Mode 1 vs 2 vs 3 vs 4 (editable PPT, auto_layout, PDF-to-PPTX) — decision tree + when NOT to enable auto_layout
Authoring a deck — cc-ppt structure (top constants, per-deck const VQA, module.exports), mandatory rules, minimal Chinese+English worked examples
Inline style overrides (Art Deco, 水墨, 国潮) OR full-TOML custom style authoring (workspace/styles/<name>.toml schema)
Long worked example (full 5-slide editable business deck, slide-canvas layout reference, TextOverlay/TextRun schemas)
Inline style-prompt quick-reference table (14 vibes), API modes (rt vs batch), timing, CLI flags, ooxml/ + pptx-scripts/ utilities
Invocation contract — write script.js OR styles/<name>.toml first, then call mofa_slides with input:<path>; per-deck const VQA at top, spliced via ${VQA}; never inline slides:[...]
Language-match rule — Chinese deck stays Chinese end-to-end (VQA + narratives + quoted text); English deck stays English; runtime no longer auto-appends English 'do not render text' clamp

tools.name: mofa_list_styles
tools.description: List the slide styles available on this deployment. Call this BEFORE picking a style so you never request one that isn't installed (avoids silent fallback). Returns name, description, variants, tags per style.

skill.description: Skill catalog to list. Defaults to 'slides'.

tools.name: mofa_slides
tools.spawn_only_message: SUCCESS: Slide generation is now running in background. The PPTX file will be automatically delivered when ready. No further action needed for this request.
tools.description: Generate AI presentation slides with full-bleed Gemini images. Supports multiple styles and editable PPTX mode. Runs in background — do NOT wait for it.

style.description: Slide variant: cover, normal, data, warm

auto_layout.description: AVOID unless user explicitly asks for VQA / OCR-based extraction or PDF-to-PPTX conversion. This pipeline (generate-with-text → VQA-extract → text-removal) is slow (+10-20s/slide), costs extra (Qwen-Edit calls), and the resulting text positions usually need heavy human cleanup. For editable slides, prefer the `texts` array (Mode 2) — author the text boxes yourself.

input.description: Relative path to a JS or JSON file containing the slides array (for example slides/<slug>/script.js).

style.description: Style template name. Call `mofa_list_styles` to see what's installed before picking — the binary will error out (not silently substitute) if the name doesn't exist. Default: nb-pro.

out.description: Output PPTX file path. Must be a file path ending in .pptx (e.g. 'deck.pptx' or 'slides/my-deck/output/deck.pptx'), NOT a directory. Use a relative path — never use /tmp or absolute paths.

slide_dir.description: Directory for intermediate PNGs (auto-created if omitted)

auto_layout.description: AVOID by default. Forces VQA + text-removal on every slide — slow, expensive, and the extracted layout usually needs manual cleanup. Only enable when the user explicitly asks for OCR/VQA extraction or PDF-to-PPTX. For editable output, prefer authoring the `texts` array per slide instead.

api.description: API mode: rt (realtime, fast) or batch (50% cheaper, async)
